method: Original PC 0x52c880 and 0x52cc90 on synthetic linked records, original Timer/PreviousResult/ResetTimer/Idle handlers and linked-list helpers. EAX condition-bank index fixed to zero. No function replacement or OS API.

contracts.conditionChain: Bit0 at condition+0x0e joins the next condition with AND. An unmarked passing final record is returned; a failing member skips the remainder of its marked group. Unchained groups are ordered alternatives. PreviousResult has a null handler and reuses the preceding float result.
contracts.action: Packet+0x24 timer increments by delta each update. Handler return zero retains current action for another frame; nonzero advances within the same update. Packet+0x50 bit0 marks the first call of an action; the dispatcher clears it before calling the handler and passes firstCall=1.

limits: No full gameplay script or inter-script interrupt/state transition emulation.
Condition variable operands, dynamic random operands and condition-bank1 remain outside these fixtures.
No claim that every parsed source file is reachable during ordinary gameplay.
